title: FDG PET SUVR and PETPVE12 partial-volume correction using OpenNeuro ds002898
description: Completed quality-controlled single-subject research portfolio demonstration using OpenNeuro ds002898: dynamic FDG PET frame selection, MCFLIRT motion correction, static PET construction, SPM12 segmentation and PET-T1 coregistration, PETPVE12 Muller-Gartner PVC, bilateral cerebellar-cortex SUVR, regional atlas summaries, and 4/5/6/8 mm PSF sensitivity analysis.
notes: Single-subject research portfolio demonstration using a healthy young adult. Not intended for clinical or diagnostic use. Raw OpenNeuro data and intermediate imaging derivatives are not included.
